themes.name: No Ground Truth to Measure Against
themes.plain: Many of these problems have no answer key to grade your work against, and the thing being measured often shifts while you measure it. So the models keep starting by building a small truth set of their own, or admitting the number is only an estimate.
themes.evidence: Answer engine optimization has no stable unit or click to attribute, cross-channel incrementality faces platforms that change delivery mid-test, identity resolution has no verified list of who is really the same person, generative content review has reviewers who disagree with each other, and the B2B buying-group problem was described today as needing unbiased ground truth for a group that hides until late.

themes.name: Incentives Before Standards
themes.plain: Several problems stall because the person holding the answer gains nothing by sharing it, and nobody can make them. A shared standard or a central system cannot settle a fight over money, credit, or turf.
themes.evidence: Agent traffic stays hidden because agents gain by looking human, journey orchestration fails because channel owners' bonuses reward sending more, semantic definitions stay split because finance, sales and marketing each need their own number, and downstream consent is unprovable partly because platforms profit from being opaque.

themes.name: Chokepoint Before Trust
themes.plain: When the models cannot trust who is acting or what happens next, they build one door they own and push everything through it. A sent email or a spent dollar cannot be taken back, so the only real control happens before the action leaves.
themes.evidence: All three models answer safe agent execution with a proxy or gateway that holds the credentials and caps spend and audience size, downstream consent work starts with one checkpoint on every path data leaves, and journey orchestration starts with a single pre-send eligibility check or contact ledger.

themes.name: Nobody Can Verify Downstream
themes.plain: Once data, money, a message, or a buying conversation leaves your own systems, you cannot see inside the partner, ad platform, trained model, or private chat that now holds it. You can estimate whether the rules were honored, but you cannot prove it.
themes.evidence: Provable consent and deletion runs into ad platforms and agency segments that expose no lineage and models with no accepted unlearning test, incrementality runs into platforms that control both the treatment and the evidence, and today's B2B answers said buying groups now decide inside private channels that cannot be observed at all.

themes.name: Judgment That Won't Compile
themes.plain: The hardest calls depend on meaning, context, and what a sentence implies, and no rule set fully captures that. The models end up shrinking human judgment into a smaller, safer box rather than removing it.
themes.evidence: Generative content review keeps coming back to whether a phrase makes a claim and whether evidence supports it, which reviewers themselves dispute, and the semantic context layer keeps coming back to conflicting but legitimate meanings of the word customer that no schema can settle.
